name: livecheck
description: Agents waste tokens and context fetching job, Shopify/HTML product, and eBay pages that are already closed, sold out, or 404, then hand the user a dead link. Livecheck checks the primary source first: job listings, HTML product stock (Shopify-class), and eBay item availability. Stdio MCP tools: verify ($0.01), check ($0.02), confirm ($0.10 / $0.25 on /confirm/order), watch / watch_renew ($2.50). Not a search engine. Payment is x402 USDC on Base via Stripe. The Cursor MCP has no wallet; unpaid calls surface HTTP 402; a wallet agent completes payment.
